title: Bounded physical erasure
statement: The system shall make deleted nodes and edges unrecoverable from data files, WAL, replicas and backups within 30 days of deletion.
rationale: GDPR Art. 17: deletes in log-structured/replicated engines leave copies in tombstones, WAL, replicas and backups.

acceptance_criteria.text: 30 days after a delete, a byte-level scan of data files, WAL segments and analytics replicas finds no plaintext of the deleted node or edge.
Backups older than the delete become unreadable for the deleted data via destruction of the associated encryption key within 30 days.

source: Research default — PO to confirm 30-day bound
